div.style: color: rgb(58, 47, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST /api/v1/auth/demo-login/ is AllowAny.
Behind a 20/hour per-IP counter it calls
call_command seed_data --clear INLINE, inside the
request, guarded by a cache lock and a
DEMO_RESET_INTERVAL_HOURS freshness key.
A single HTTP request can therefore truncate and
re-seed the whole database.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 47, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WHAT IS NOT HERE, despite looking like it might be.
No Celery, no Redis, no broker, no scheduler anywhere in
requirements.txt or settings. Overdue notification mail is an
admin POST to send_overdue_notifications, sent synchronously in
the request. Excel and PDF generation, bulk import and the demo
reseed all run in the web worker too. The DatabaseCache is the
only piece of shared state between gunicorn workers.
